_ordering_rationale: Ordre PV décroissante. Covestro polymères : 2 segments reportables Performance Materials (commodities polymères) + Solutions & Specialties (premium). EBITDA et FOCF = signaux clés cycle chimie.

kpis.signal: Segment commodity polymères (MDI, TDI, polycarbonates), cyclique, ~54% CA FY24
kpis.description_fr: Polyuréthanes (MDI, TDI), polycarbonates, chimie de base. Segment commodity exposé cycle chimie + énergie EU. ~54% CA Covestro.
kpis.description_en: Polyurethanes (MDI, TDI), polycarbonates, base chemicals. Commodity segment exposed to chemicals cycle + EU energy. ~54% of Covestro revenue.

kpis.signal: Segment premium (coatings, adhésifs, plastiques ingéniérie), marges supérieures
kpis.description_fr: 6 business : Engineering Plastics, Coatings & Adhesives, Tailored Urethanes, TPU, Specialty Films, Elastomers. Segment premium à plus forte valeur ajoutée.
kpis.description_en: 6 businesses: Engineering Plastics, Coatings & Adhesives, Tailored Urethanes, TPU, Specialty Films, Elastomers. Premium higher-value segment.

kpis.signal: Pic FY21 (3.09 Mds), effondrement post-énergie EU FY22-FY24 (~70% de baisse), guidance 2025 1.0-1.4 Mds
kpis.description_fr: EBITDA ajusté. Pic historique 2021 à 3.09 Mds. Effondrement 2022+ sur crise énergie EU + cycle chimie bas. Marge EBITDA ~7.5% FY24 vs ~17% FY21.
kpis.description_en: Adjusted EBITDA. Historical peak FY21 at €3.09B. Collapsed 2022+ on EU energy crisis + chemicals cycle trough. ~7.5% FY24 EBITDA margin vs ~17% FY21.

kpis.signal: Effondrement FY24 -62%, sous pression continue, signal stress balance sheet
kpis.description_fr: FOCF = EBITDA - capex - capital travail variation. Indicateur clé deleveraging. Stress FY24 confirme cycle bas non encore résolu.
kpis.description_en: FOCF = EBITDA - capex - working capital change. Key deleveraging indicator. FY24 stress confirms unresolved cyclical trough.

kpis.signal: Endettement net en hausse continue depuis FY22, ratio Net Debt/EBITDA ~2.5x FY24
kpis.description_fr: Endettement net. Détérioration continue sur effet ciseau (EBITDA bas + FOCF négatif/quasi-nul). Sous surveillance, contexte OPA ADNOC en cours.
kpis.description_en: Net debt. Continuous deterioration on scissors effect (low EBITDA + negative/near-zero FOCF). Under watch, ADNOC takeover process ongoing.

_notes: Source 10-K équivalent (annual report) Covestro AG FY20-FY24. Données sales segment précises 2023-2024. Historique 2020-2022 reconstitué via rapports successifs (FY20 sales ~10.7Mds total avant split en 2 nouveaux segments). Contexte OPA ADNOC (XRG) annoncée 2024 à €62/action.
